title: Kissinger-Dobrynin transcript on microwave beams at Moscow embassy

plain: A recently declassified transcript from the 1970s, from talks between the US and the Soviet Union on limiting nuclear arms and easing tensions, shows the US official Henry Kissinger raising with the Soviet ambassador Anatoly Dobrynin the microwave beams aimed at the US Embassy in Moscow, with the US diplomat Walter Stoessel also named. Michels brings it up himself, citing the document, as proof that energy weapons were a live concern between the two powers.
